name: Minecraft: SpongeVanilla
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: SpongeVanilla, the Minecraft Java server that runs Sponge plugins without mods. Any Minecraft version Sponge has, checked against Sponge's checksums.
startup: read -r need most 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v most="$most" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } if (most != "" && have + 0 > most + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version runs on Java %s at most, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", most, have, most; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: SpongeVanilla. Downloads the SpongeVanilla build for the
# chosen Minecraft version from Sponge and checks it against Sponge's
# checksum. Worlds, plugins and settings are never touched, and the jar is
# only replaced once the new one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# True when version $1 is $2 or older.
older_or_same() { [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = "$1" ]; }
# Downloads $1 to $2 and checks it against $3, its published checksum
# (sha256:…, sha1:… or md5:…); a jar with none must at least be a whole
# zip. Only then is it put in place.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$2.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.new"; fail "The download from $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ]; then
        if [ "$("${3%%:*}sum" "$2.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${3#*:}" ]; then
            rm -f "$2.new"
            fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        fi
    elif [[ $2 == *.jar ]] && ! unzip -tq "$2.new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$2.new"
        fail "The download isn't a whole jar file. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.new" "$2"
}
# True when file $1 has the checksum $2 (as fetch takes it).
matches() { [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$("${2%%:*}sum" "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${2#*:}" ]; }
# The Java version Minecraft $1 needs, from Mojang's version list (8 for
# versions older than the list says).
java_for() {
    local url
    url=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$1" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url') || true
    if [ -n "$url" ]; then get "$url" | jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' || echo 8; else echo 8; fi
}
# Writes the Java versions the server runs on to .raptor-java, which the
# startup command checks: the oldest, and for $2 the newest, if any.
write_java() {
    echo "$1${2:+ $2}" > .raptor-java
}
# The newest Java that Forge, and the servers built on Forge or on its
# launcher, run on for Minecraft $1: 8 before 1.13 (LaunchWrapper), 11
# before 1.17 (the old ModLauncher fails on Java 16's locked-down
# internals). Nothing for newer versions.
java_most() {
    [[ $1 == 1.* ]] || return 0
    if older_or_same "$1" 1.12.2; then echo 8
    elif older_or_same "$1" 1.16.5; then echo 11; fi
}
# How to say which Java it runs on.
java_text() {
    if [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then echo "Java $1 or newer"
    elif [ "$1" = "$2" ]; then echo "Java $1 only"
    else echo "Java $1 to $2"; fi
}

sponge_api=https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts
# Picks the Sponge build of artifact $1 (spongevanilla, spongeforge or
# spongeneo) for Minecraft $2 (or latest) and the version choice $3
# (recommended, latest, or a full version such as 1.21.4-14.0.0), setting
# sponge_version, sponge_json (its details) and mc.
sponge_pick() {
    local artifact=$1 want=$2 choice=$3 tags newest
    tags=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact" | jq -r '.tags.minecraft[]') ||
        fail "Sponge's version list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    newest=$(grep -E '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+$' <<<"$tags" | head -n 1)
    case "$choice" in
    recommended | latest | "")
        mc=$want
        [ "$mc" = latest ] && mc=$newest
        grep -qxF -- "$mc" <<<"$tags" ||
            fail "Sponge has no Minecraft $mc. Set Minecraft version to latest, or to a version Sponge has, such as $newest."
        sponge_version=""
        if [ "$choice" != latest ]; then
            sponge_version=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions?tags=minecraft:$mc&recommended=true&limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys_unsorted[0] // empty') || true
        fi
        if [ -z "$sponge_version" ]; then
            sponge_version=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions?tags=minecraft:$mc&limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys_unsorted[0] // empty') || true
            [ -n "$sponge_version" ] || fail "Sponge has no build for Minecraft $mc to install."
            [ "$choice" = latest ] || echo "Minecraft $mc has no recommended Sponge build, so this is its newest one."
        fi
        ;;
    *) sponge_version=$choice ;;
    esac
    sponge_json=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions/$sponge_version") ||
        fail "Sponge has no version $sponge_version. Set Sponge version to recommended, latest, or a version Sponge has."
    local got
    got=$(jq -r '.tags.minecraft' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ "$want" = latest ] || [ "$want" = "$got" ] ||
        fail "Sponge $sponge_version is for Minecraft $got, not $want. Set Minecraft version to $got or latest."
    mc=$got
}
# The download link and checksum of the build's server jar.
sponge_jar() {
    sponge_url=$(jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.extension == "jar" and (.classifier == "universal" or .classifier == ""))] | sort_by(.classifier != "universal") | .[0].downloadUrl // empty' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ -n "$sponge_url" ] || fail "Sponge $sponge_version has no server jar to download."
    local sum
    if sum=$(get "$sponge_url.sha256" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        sponge_sum="sha256:${sum%% *}"
    else
        sponge_sum="md5:$(jq -r --arg u "$sponge_url" '.assets[] | select(.downloadUrl == $u) | .md5' <<<"$sponge_json")"
    fi
}

jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
sponge_pick spongevanilla "${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}" "${SV_VERSION:-recommended}"
sponge_jar
if matches "$jar" "$sponge_sum"; then
    echo "SpongeVanilla $sponge_version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading SpongeVanilla $sponge_version"
    fetch "$sponge_url" "$jar" "$sponge_sum"
fi
need=$(java_for "$mc")
most=$(java_most "$mc")
write_java "$need" "$most"
echo "Installed SpongeVanilla $sponge_version for Minecraft $mc. It runs on $(java_text "$need" "$most")."
